source: AWS EC2 on-demand, Linux, us-east-1, retrieved 2026-11-09 from ec2instances.info (Vantage), which republishes the AWS Price List API
physical_core_hour_basis: c7i.xlarge $0.1785/h for 4 vCPUs = 2 physical cores (Intel Sapphire Rapids)
gpu_hour_basis: g6.xlarge (NVIDIA L4, 24 GiB) $0.8048/h minus its 2 physical cores. The measured GPU is an RTX A6000, which AWS does not rent; g6.xlarge is the cheapest current-generation NVIDIA GPU instance. gpu_alternatives and break_even_gpu_hour are given so the result does not depend on this choice
break_even_basis: price at which 8 cores plus one GPU costs the same per write as native RocksDB on 32 cores (equal-cost campaign, untuned); above every GPU listed here
